summary:
Ethiopia and Eritrea have severed diplomatic ties as fighting continues in northern Ethiopia. Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of backing the Tigray People’s Liberation Front, while both governments accuse the other of fuelling internal conflicts. Separately, the United States is sending a third aircraft carrier and up to 10,000 more troops to the Middle East as President Trump weighs resuming bombing Iran after the midterms.

Student protests have spread across France, where about 400 schools are closed after fires and clashes with police. Ministers have called for a day of dialogue, while students have called for further strike action. Tennessee has suspended executions and ordered an independent inquiry after Christa Pike survived two lethal injections and was left in critical condition; the case has prompted calls for a US death penalty moratorium.

Flydubai is preparing flights to return Israelis from the UAE after a co-pilot attacked Captain Smit Machchhar on a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. Machchhar said he fought back to protect passengers, and service between the cities had been suspended. South Korea has demanded an apology from Ukraine over disclosure of the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul, warning of unspecified measures. Taiwan has received two US-made F-16V fighter jets, the first under an order placed in 2019.

headlines.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea sever diplomatic ties as fighting escalates
headlines.summary: Ethiopia and Eritrea have broken diplomatic ties as fighting continues in northern Ethiopia. Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of backing the Tigray People’s Liberation Front, while the two governments accuse each other of fuelling internal conflicts.

headlines.title: US plans more troops and a third carrier near Iran
headlines.summary: The United States is sending a third aircraft carrier and up to 10,000 additional troops to the Middle East. The deployments come as President Trump weighs whether to resume bombing Iran after the midterms.

headlines.title: Protests force 400 French schools to close
headlines.summary: Student protests that began in the Paris region have spread across France, with fires and clashes with police reported. About 400 schools are closed; ministers have called for a day of dialogue, while students have called for further strike action.

headlines.title: Tennessee suspends executions after Christa Pike survives injection
headlines.summary: Tennessee suspended executions and ordered an independent inquiry after Christa Pike survived two lethal injections and was left in critical condition. The failed execution has prompted calls from lawyers, doctors and faith leaders for a US death penalty moratorium.

headlines.title: Flydubai resumes plans to return Israelis after cockpit attack
headlines.summary: Flydubai is preparing flights to bring Israelis back from the UAE after a co-pilot attacked the captain on a Dubai-to-Tel Aviv flight. Captain Smit Machchhar said he fought back to protect passengers; service between the cities had been suspended.

headlines.title: South Korea demands Ukraine apologise over North Korean prisoners
headlines.summary: South Korea has demanded an apology from Ukraine over the disclosure of the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war to Seoul. President Lee Jae Myung warned of unspecified further measures if Kyiv does not acknowledge a confidentiality agreement.

headlines.title: Taiwan receives first new F-16V fighter jets from the US
headlines.summary: Two US-made F-16V fighter jets have arrived in Taiwan, the first delivered under an order placed in 2019. Taiwan called their arrival a sign of continuing US military support as concerns grow about Washington’s commitment to the island.
